convert_internvl_weights_to_hf: convert InternVL model weights from OpenGVLab format to HuggingFace Transformers format using argparse CLI
build_internvl_config: build InternVL configuration from original model path including vision, text, and projection config parameters
convert_state_dict_keys: convert original InternVL state dict keys to HuggingFace compatible key names using regex mappings
create_internvl_processor: create InternVL processor with image, video, and tokenizer components including chat template for multimodal input
save_internvl_tokenizer: save InternVL tokenizer with special tokens and chat template for Qwen2 or Llama language model variants
